title: Classic British Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and comforting lamb stew recipe inspired by traditional British cuisine. This dish is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
4. Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the chopped carrot and potato to the pot and cook for another 5 minutes.
6. Add the red wine, beef broth, thyme, and rosemary to the pot.
7. Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a boil.
8. Return the lamb shoulder to the pot and cover it with a lid.
9. Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise the stew for 2.5 hours.
10. Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
11. Serve the lamb stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
